item.title: Choose how to share your daily check-in
item.summary: New challenges let you share a photo, a short line of words, a heart-rate graph, a route map or a pushup tape.
item.details: Each day can use a different kind. Your partner sees only a posting time and blurred preview until they post too; the recap reveals the shared entries. Heart-rate and route uploads contain summaries and rendered images, without raw heart-rate samples or route coordinates. Existing photo-only and heart-rate challenges keep their rules.
